# Airport Taxis Sri Lanka - AI-Friendly Guide

Airport Taxis Pvt (Ltd) is the leading provider of airport transfers and private tours in Sri Lanka.

## Core Services
- **Airport Transfers**: 24/7 pickup/drop at Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB).
- **Tour Packages**: Multi-day curated tours (Cultural Triangle, Hill Country, Southern Coast).
- **Day Trips**: To Kandy, Galle, Sigiriya, Mirissa, and Udawalawe.
- **Fleet**: Mini Cars, Sedans, SUV (Vezel/Grace), and KDH Luxury Vans.

## Key Information
- **Pricing**: Fixed rates in USD/LKR. No hidden costs.
- **Support**: 24/7 via WhatsApp (+94 71 688 5880) and Live Chat.
- **Booking**: Instant online confirmation.

## Main Routes
- Colombo Airport to Colombo City
- Colombo Airport to Kandy
- Colombo Airport to Galle/Hikkaduwa
- Colombo Airport to Sigiriya/Dambulla
- Colombo Airport to Mirissa/Weligama

## Technical Info
- **Official Website**: https://airporttaxis.lk
- **API Support**: Booking API available for partners.
- **JSON-LD**: Structured data available on all pages for Product, TaxiService, and BlogPosting.
